billingPage.faqA1: Metsotso e sa sebelisoang e fetisetsoa khoeling e latelang ea almanaka. E felloa ke nako khoeling ea boraro.
billingPage.faqQ2: Nka hlakola ngoliso ea ka neng kapa neng?

billingPage.faqQ4: Ho hlokahala mofani ofe oa SIP telephony?

billing.faq1A: Netefatso ea karete e hlokahala ha u ingolisa. Phumano e felletseng e fanoa ka matsatsi a 7 ntle le tefiso. Kamora teko, €120/khoeli e tla lefisoa ka boiketsetso. Hlakola pele ho matsatsi a 7 ho qoba litefiso.
billing.faq1Q: Teko ea matsatsi a 7 e sebetsa joang?
billing.faq2A: Meralo ka bobeli e fana ka phumano e felletseng ho likarolo tsohle tsa tšebeletso. Enterprise e kenyelletsa ho seta ka mokhoa o ikhethileng bakeng sa lebitso la hau le mecha ea litaba ea sechaba e laoloang ka bongata ka API ea rona (re u laolela liakhaonto).
billing.faq2Q: Phapang ke efe lipakeng tsa Premium le Enterprise?
billing.faq3A: U hokela linotlolo tsa hau tsa API bakeng sa lits'ebeletso tsa kantle (Google Veo, FAL/Kling, Runway, OpenAI, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Claude). TrendFlow e li sebelisa bakeng sa tlhahiso ea video/lentsoe/avatar. U lefa lits'ebeletso tsena ka kotloloho ka litefiso tsa tsona.
billing.faq3Q: Ho bolelang 'tlhahiso ka li-API tse hoketsoeng'?
billing.faq4A: E, patlisiso ea mekhoa le tlhahlobo ha li na moeli ho meralo ea Premium le Enterprise.
billing.faq4Q: Na tlhahlobo ea mekhoa ha e na moeli?
billing.faq5A: E, neng kapa neng ho tsoa karete ea moralo e kaholimo. Ho nchafatsa ka boiketsetso ho tla timisoa, 'me phumano e tla sala ho fihlela qetellong ea nako e lefuoang.
billing.faq6A: E. Kenya khoutu ea hau ea promo kaholimo; theolelo e tla sebetsa ha u ingolisa ho Premium ka Stripe.
billing.faq6Q: Na likhoutu tsa promo lia sebetsa?
billing.genApiBaseHint: Ts'ebetso ea mantlha (ho hlophisa, ho fomata, litlotla, lentsoe la Piper, ho romela) e sebetsa ntle le linotlolo tsa kantle.

billing.faq49Q1: Teko ea matsatsi a 7 ea mahala e sebetsa joang?
billing.faq49A1: Ha u lefa u tlameha ho netefatsa karete ea banka ka Stripe — hoa hlokahala, empa ha ho letho le lefisoang ka matsatsi a 7 'me u fumana phihlello e felletseng. Ha teko e fela, €49/khoeli e lefisoa ka bo eona. Hlakola pele matsatsi a 7 a fela 'me u ke ke ua lefisoa letho.
billing.faq49A2: Khetla ea autopilot: ho batla le ho hlahloba mekhoa, ho shebana le bamameli, studio sa UGC, Chrome extension, Publisher e nang le moralo oa litaba, autopilot le Gallery. Tlhahiso ea AI ka bo eona ha e kenyelelitsoe — e sebetsa ka lipeeletso tsa hau (Google Flow, NotebookLM, HeyGen) kapa li-API keys tsa hau, 'me u lefa bafani ka ho toba ka litefiso tsa bona.
billing.faq49Q3: Hobaneng ha lipeeletso li theko e tlase ho feta API?
billing.faq49A3: Bafani ba rekisa likalimo tsa peeletso ka theko e tlase haholo ho feta metsotso e tšoanang ka API: Veo ka peeletso ea Google AI e theko e tlase ka makhetlo a 2–10, li-avatar tsa HeyGen li theko e tlase ka makhetlo a 3. 'Me NotebookLM ha e na API ea sechaba ho hang — peeletso feela. Extension e iketsetsa mosebetsi ka har'a li-account tsa hau, e u fa boiketlo bo tšoanang le ba API ka litheko tsa peeletso. Lipalo tse nepahetseng li tafoleng le khalkuleita e ka holimo.
billing.faq49Q4: Ke lipeeletso life tseo ke tla li hloka?
billing.faq49A4: Tse peli li lekane ho qala: Google AI Pro (€21.99/khoeli — Flow video + NotebookLM e nang le meeli e phahameng) le HeyGen Creator ($29/khoeli — metsotso e ka bang 30 ea Avatar IV). Tšebeletso e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe e boetse e na le meeli ea mahala (Flow — likalimo tse 50/letsatsi, NotebookLM — li-overviews tse 3/letsatsi, HeyGen — livideo tse 3/khoeli), kahoo u ka leka pipeline ntle le lipeeletso ho hang.
billing.faq49Q5: Nka sebetsa ka li-API keys feela?
billing.faq49A5: E. Hokela li-keys tsa hau (Google Veo, FAL/Kling, Runway, OpenAI, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Claude) ho Settings 'me tšebeletso e hlahisa ka tsona ka ho toba, ha ho hlokahale extension. U lefa lits'ebeletso tseo ka litefiso tsa tsona. Litsela li kopana ka bolokolohi: li-avatar ka peeletso, voice-over ka API, mohlala.
billing.faq49Q6: Ke hlakola joang? Konopo e hokae?
billing.faq49A6: Ka holimo leqepheng lena, kareting ea “Moralo oa hau”, konopo ea “Tima ho nchafatsa ka boithaopo” e hlaha ha peeletso e ntse e sebetsa. Linako tse lefuoang ha li khutlisetsoe chelete, empa phihlello e tšoarella ho fihlela nako e fela. E time nakong ea teko 'me u ke ke ua lefisoa ho hang. U ka e qala hape ka ho tobetsa hanngoe nako efe kapa efe pele nako e fela.
billing.faq49Q7: Na likhoutu tsa papatso lia sebetsa?
billing.faq49A7: E. Kenya khoutu ea papatso ka holimo — theolelo e sebetsa ha u reka Premium ka Stripe.
billing.disclaimer49: TrendTraffic ha e amane le Google, HeyGen, ElevenLabs kapa Blotato. Katoloso e iketsetsa mosebetsi ka har'a liakhaonto tsa hau — latela lipehelo tsa tšebeletso tsa mofani e mong le e mong. Litheko tsa bafani li qotsitsoe ho lethathamo la litheko tsa molao ho tloha ka Phupu 2026 'me li ka fetoha.

billing.fg49G7I4: Mohatisi o tlas'a taolo: kemiso ea libaka, linako tse fumanehang, liketane tsa ho hatisa ka boiketsetso

landing.featH2a: Ha ho lisebelisoa. Ha ho ho seta.
landing.featIntro: VibeVox e sebetsa ka kotloloho ho sebatli sa hau. Theha kamore ea liboka ka ho tobetsa hanngoe, kopitsa sehokelo, 'me u se romele ho motho oa hau ho WhatsApp kapa Telegram — ba hokela hang-hang, 'me ka bobeli ba utloana ba fetoleloa puong ea bona ea matsoalloa. Ha ho hlokahale ho ingolisa bakeng sa molekane oa hau.
landing.featLearnText: AI Learning Hub e ikamahanya le mantsoe a hau a khethehileng le lipuo tsa libaka tse 96 — Searabia sa Egepeta, Sepanishe sa Latin America. Ka hora e le 'ngoe feela ea tšebeliso.
landing.featLearnTitle: E utloisisa slang le lipuo tsa hau
landing.featPriceText: Theko e tlase ka ho fetisisa 'marakeng oa phetolelo e ts'oanang. Lefa feela metsotso e fetolelitsoeng — ha ho peeletso kapa konteraka ea selemo le selemo.
landing.featPriceTitle: €0.17 ka motsotso — theko e tlase ka makhetlo a 5–15
landing.featRolloverText: Chelete e sa sebelisoang e fetisetsoa khoeling e latelang ka bo eona. Hang ha e lefiloe, metsotso ke ea hau ntle le nako e behiloeng.
landing.featRolloverTitle: Metsotso ha e felloe ke nako
landing.featShareText: Romela sehokelo ka WhatsApp kapa Telegram — motho oa hau o hokela ka kotloloho ho sebatli sa hae. Ha ho App Store, lefapha la IT, kapa ho seta. E sebetsa sesebelisoa leha e le sefe.
landing.featShareTitle: Sehokelo ho e-na le ho kenya
landing.featVoiceText: Mantsoe a HD Aoede le Charon. Gemini e fetolela molumo ka kotloloho ho molumo — ha ho STT→text→TTS chain. Nako ea ho lieha e ka tlase ho 0.5 motsotso, moqoqo o phalla ka tlhaho.
landing.finalH2: Bua puo e le 'ngoe le lefats'e lohle
landing.finalSub: Ingolise ka motsotso. Matsatsi a 7 a pele mahala.
landing.heroKicker: Phetolelo e ts'oanang ea AI bakeng sa mehala ea video
landing.heroLead: Phetolelo e potlakileng ea litsela tse peli bakeng sa liboka tsa video le mehala ea SIP ka lipuo tse 100+. Mantsoe a HD, nako ea ho lieha e ka tlase ho 0.5 motsotso, €0.17 feela ka motsotso.
landing.hintsText: Ho SIP telephony, AI e ngola moqoqo ka nako ea sebele 'me e bontša likarabo tse lokisitsoeng ho mookameli. Ka mor'a mohala — lintlha tsa bohlokoa, li-trigger, le li-tag li ea ka bo eona ho CRM (Chatwoot, Questflow). Hokela ho Zadarma, Twilio, le SIP gateway efe kapa efe.
landing.hintsTitle: Lintlha tse bohlale nakong ea mohala

landing.noBurnText: Ka SaaS ea khale, metsotso e sa sebelisoang e felloa ke nako khoeli le khoeli. VibeVox e e fetisetsa ka hloko ho e latelang — ha u lahleheloe ke motsotsoana oa nako e lefiloeng.

hotebook.kindErrorBody: Etsa bonnete ba hore keketso e kentsoe le hore tab ya NotebookLM e bulehile, ebe o tobetsa 'Hlahloba'.
hotebook.kindLoginBody: Keketso e hokahane, empa ha o so kene ho notebooklm.google.com. Bula sebaka sa marang-rang ebe o kena ka akhaonto ea hau ea Google — boemo bo tla ntlafatsoa ka bo bona.
hotebook.kindLoginTitle: Ho hlokahala ho kena ka Google (NotebookLM)
hotebook.kindOfflineBody: Kenya keketso e kopaneng ea TrendTraffic (Litlhophiso → tab ya 'Generation') 'me u boloke tab ya notebooklm.google.com e bulehile ho sebatli se tšoanang moo u kentseng TrendTraffic. Keketso e hokela ka bo eona.
hotebook.kindOfflineTitle: Keketso ea Hotebook ha e inthaneteng
hotebook.lead: E sebetsa ka keketso e kopaneng ea TrendTraffic Chrome ho sebatli sa hau tlasa ho kena ha hau ha Google. Akhaonto e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe ea Enterprise e na le khokahano le meeli ea eona.
hotebook.privacyNote: Ena ke akhaonto ea hau ea Google e nang le meeli le libuka tsa hau — ha li kopane le bareki ba bang. Ho khothaletsoa akhaonto e arohaneng e nang le moralo oa Google AI (Plus/Pro/Ultra): meeli ea letsatsi le letsatsi ea NotebookLM (molumo/video/chat) e baloa ka akhaonto. Sethala ha se boloke li-cookies tsa hau tsa Google — ho kena ha hau ho lula ho sebatli sa hau.

ttLanding.f1Text: Hlahloba li-platform tse tharo ka niche le sebaka sa geo. "Audience targeting": hlalosa sehlahisoa sa hau — AI e tla tlatsa bamameli ka boiketsetso, e khethe mantsoe a bohlokoa ka lipuo tse 29, 'me e fumane li-niche tse nang le tlhokahalo ea sebele. Liteishene tsa bahlolisani lethathamong la ho shebella le nalane ea metric.
ttLanding.f1Title: Mekhoa — pele ho mang kapa mang
ttLanding.f2Text: Peista sehokelo sa video efe kapa efe ea TikTok, Instagram, kapa YouTube — Gemini e tla e senya foreimi ka foreimi: hook, morethetho, sebopeho, litlhaloso. Ho senya le litlhaloso li tla ea gallery, 'me "TrendDNA" e tla tataisa video ea hau ea nako e tlang ka boiketsetso.
ttLanding.f2Title: Recipe ea virality — foreimi ka foreimi
ttLanding.f3Text: Mekhoa e mene: solo, moqoqo oa batho ba babeli, mongolo oa hau "joalo ka ha o le teng", tataiso e thehiloeng ho tlhahlobo ea mekhoa. Ponahalo ea HeyGen e seng e entsoe kapa avatar ho tsoa fotong ea hau, mantsoe ohle a ElevenLabs ho kenyeletsa li-clones, mekhoa ea litlhaloso tse phelang, le lisebelisoa tsa brand.
ttLanding.f3Title: Avatar e bua bakeng sa hau
ttLanding.f4Text: Ho beha leihlo mekhoa ho fetola liphumano hore e be livideo tse seng li entsoe ho latela template ea hau. Liketane tsa ho hatisa ka boiketsetso li aba lifomate ka boiketsetso ho pholletsa le li-platform le libaka — TikTok, YouTube, le Instagram li fumana litaba ka kemiso.
ttLanding.f4Title: Moralo oa litaba oa khoeli le khoeli — ntle le uena

Theha senotlolo sa hau sa botho ho Lisebelisoa, se manamise ho Claude, 'me mothusi o tla hlahloba mekhoa, a fane ka maikutlo a bamameli le mantsoe a bohlokoa, 'me a bontše gallery ea hau le kemiso ea ho phatlalatsa. Lipolelo tse bonolo, ha ho li-tab.

ttLanding.priceBody: Premium — phihlello e felletseng ho li-module tsohle. Matsatsi a 7 a pele mahala, ha ho litefiso, hlakola neng kapa neng.
ttLanding.savBody: Chrome extension ea rona e ikhethileng e hokahanya lits'ebeletso tsa AI ho sebelisa lipeeletso tsa hau tse teng ho fapana le ho lefa ka likoloto tsa API. Le linotlolo tsa hau (BYOK) — Gemini, ElevenLabs, TikHub, Blotato — li sebetsa ka kotloloho, ntle le litefiso tsa bohareng.

ttLanding.stBody: Ho batla mekhoa e metle, ho hlahloba livideo tse tsamaeang, li-avatar, li-voiceover, li-subtitle, livideo tse iketselitsoeng, le ho beha livideo ka boiketsetso—kaofela sebakeng se le seng. Kopanya linotlolo tsa litšebeletso tsa hau kapa li-subscription ebe u lefa ka mokhoa o theko e tlase ho uena.

ttLanding.step1Text: Scanner ea rona e akaretsa TikTok, Instagram, le YouTube ho latela niche ea hau, sebaka, le puo. AI targeter ea rona e fumana li-micro-niche le mantsoe a bohlokoa, e li beha boemong ho latela tlhokahalo ea 'nete.
ttLanding.step2Text: Gemini analytics e arola livideo tse tsamaeang ka li-hook, morethetho, le sebopeho. U fumana TrendDNA—risepe ea studio sa hau sa video, hammoho le li-subtitle tsa mantlha.
ttLanding.step3Text: Studio sa rona sa UGC se etsa livideo tsa AI avatar: ponahalo e lokisitsoeng kapa avatar e tsoang fotong ea hau, mantsoe a ElevenLabs ka lipuo tse 29, li-cut-in, li-subtitle, le kit ea brand. Lifomate 9:16 le 16:9.
ttLanding.step4Text: Autopilot e beha leihlo mekhoa e metle le ho kopanya livideo ho sebelisa li-template, ha Publisher e li hlophisa matsatsi a 35 pele: 9:16 bakeng sa TikTok, 16:9 bakeng sa YouTube.

storyboard.genIntroOmni: Enjene ea Omni Flash: moloko o le mong ka chunk — foreimi e qalang "e phela" ho latela prompt ea phanele, ka lentsoe la hau la pele le behiloeng holim'a sona. Litšenyehelo ≈$1/chunk (~10s × $0.10) ho tsoa senotlolo sa hau sa Gemini. Chunk 1 pele!

storyboard.genIntroFlow2: Enjene ea Flow — KA BOEONA: bula labs.google → Flow ho sebatli sa hau ka katoloso ea TrendTraffic 'me u tobetse konopo e ka tlase. Katoloso e tla kenya chunk le storyboard ka boeona, e kenye prompt, e hlahise, 'me e khutlise sekotwana — chunk ka chunk, le bakeng sa video e telele (Flow limit ~8s/clip, ke ka lebaka leo re khaolang ho 8s). Re tla beha lentsoe la pele holim'a sona ka borona. Mokhoa oa letsoho — likonopo likareteng.
